verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only Greenhouse's own branded job boards and a Job Board API that exposes published jobs as JSON. Neither shows one posting being distributed to LinkedIn, Indeed, or aggregators, or sponsored-post management inside the ATS. The API is a developer building block and the branded boards are an adjacent careers-page feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS
